sections.quote: Nell, the electrician who came out, was on time and professional. He not only fixed the problem, he pointed out that there were unprotected wires that should be in a coupler. I appreciated his attention to detail, as well as his ability to look at the big picture.
sections.name: Cynthia G.

sections.heading: Homes, Businesses and Industrial Sites, One Wichita Office
body: ElectriCraft works out of 1218 E 18th St North in Wichita, open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. For homes, the work customers describe runs from a single bathroom receptacle to a rebuilt service drop line.
Businesses call for commercial electrical installation. Industrial sites call for repairs.
list: Meter boxes and service drop lines

image.alt: Electrician testing a wall outlet at a Wichita home

sections.heading: A Panel Updated and a New Garage Wired
body: Billie V. had her panel updated and her new garage wired. It was not her first call to ElectriCraft, she wrote, and it won't be her last.

image.alt: Electrical panel with breakers and labeled circuits

sections.quote: Jimmy and his crew were very efficient and knowledgeable. Everything looks so much nicer. They don't leave a huge mess, they are very cleanly. They are polite and will make good on a job! We appreciate them so much. We are highly satisfied with our new breaker box.
sections.name: Vera W.

sections.heading: A Live Line Sagging Over His Garage Roof for Over a Month
body: A severe storm damaged Jim H.'s service drop line, and he says the utility left a live line sagging across his garage roof for over a month. ElectriCraft rebuilt the damaged riser, ran new conductors and installed a new weatherhead and mast kit.
The office pushed the utility's dispatch on his behalf through weeks of delays, and an extra call-out fee those delays caused was written off. He described the work as compliant with city code.

image.alt: Electrician working at a meter box on a brick wall

sections.quote: He was very thorough, knowledgeable, and professional. He addressed all of the concerns that the buyers requested we fix and even found another issue that the inspector didn't catch. It only took 2 hours and the price was very reasonable!
sections.name: Catherine S.

sections.heading: A Trench Backfilled and an Inspection That Was Almost a Formality
body: Mike D. wanted power extended to a new shed. The electrician who came to estimate showed a strong interest in what he needed, asked questions and offered options that would save him money.
The job was scheduled a day later, and the crew arrived and started on time. Yard damage stayed to a minimum, the conduit trench was backfilled and the city inspection was almost a formality.

sections.heading: Outlets for Verdant Coven Plant Co.
body: Eva T. had outlets installed while her plant shop, Verdant Coven Plant Co., was being built out. In her words, the electrician went above and beyond in every way possible.
With so many moving parts to juggle, she found that someone reliable and knowledgeable made a real difference. He pays attention to detail and takes pride in his work.

sections.heading: Fox & Hound and a Facility: The Commercial Side
body: Thomas M. has had multiple jobs done at both his residence and his place of business. Jerry W. has ElectriCraft working at his facility, where the communication is excellent and the work is good and affordable.
Commercial projects have included Fox & Hound Restaurant and Ultimate Electronics, along with emergency lighting. Industrial jobs are electrical repairs.

sections.heading: Two Home Generators, Two Brands
body: Matt B. had an error code on a Kohler generator troubleshot, and his father has used the company for years. After a storm knocked out power, the office scheduled next-day service so the generator would keep running.

A Briggs & Stratton home generator was Edwin Z.'s job. The electrician told him it was a brand he had never worked on before. A year later, Edwin says, the unit comes on weekly, uses no oil and has given him no problems.

sections.heading: From a Bathroom Receptacle to a Rebuilt Service Drop Line
sections.intro: Repair and lighting have their own pages. Everything else customers have called about is below, along with commercial installation and industrial repairs.

sections.heading: Can You Come Today? What If the Utility Is the Holdup?

items.a: Call (316) 264-3359 and say how urgent it is. If you see smoke or sparks, or smell burning, get everyone out and call 911 first.
Aaron G. wrote that his job was completed at the price quoted and passed inspection with no issues.

items.q: What if the utility is the holdup?
items.a: Jim H. wrote that the office pushed Evergy's dispatch for him through weeks of delays. Taryn S. wrote that Jimmy called Evergy to confirm a new meter box was all it needed to replace.

items.q: Do you only work on houses?
items.a: No. We install commercial electrical, including emergency lighting, and repair industrial facilities.

sections.heading: Call Before You Keep Resetting That Breaker
sections.text: Call (316) 264-3359 and tell us which breaker keeps tripping.

hero.h1: Electrical Repair in Wichita, KS — ElectriCraft
hero.sub: An outlet that quit, a breaker that keeps tripping, lights that flicker. Call (316) 264-3359 and tell us what it's doing.

image.alt: Electrician testing a wall outlet with a meter at a Wichita home

sections.quote: The technician explained why certain things had stopped working, what needed to be done, some things we needed to be aware of in an older house, and finished the job in no time. They'll be our first call if another problem arises. Also: AFFORDABLE.
sections.name: Lauren D.

sections.heading: Lights That Went Out, Many Issues at Once
body: Some of Anna J.'s lights went out. The electrician came by to check things out and was on time for the appointment, which she called amazing since other services often keep you waiting. She was relieved to have things up and working again. They were very polite and went out of their way to make sure everything was right, she added.
Julie K. had many issues at once and appreciated ElectriCraft coming right out on a Sunday. Jimmy fixed them all, she wrote.
She plans to call next time she is in a pinch.

image.alt: Open modern electrical panel with breakers and labeled circuits

sections.quote: I had an odd issue that was difficult to track down. Every time Jimmy showed up, the issue would stop. Eventually we were able to get him there at the same time the issue was happening. He tracked it down and fixed it.
sections.name: Nick B.

sections.heading: A $4,200 Quote and a $400 Fix
body: Another electric company quoted Hope S. $4,200. She called ElectriCraft, and Matthew checked out the issue and fixed it. The cost was $400.
She could not be more pleased, she wrote, with the expertise and integrity of the company.

sections.heading: Several Visits Since Starting a 1910 Bungalow Restoration
body: Danny L. has had Julian out several times since he began restoring his 1910 bungalow. The work has been excellent, and Julian knows a lot about how they used to do things back in the day.
Danny plans to have him back as the restoration continues, and he recommends both the electrician and the company.

sections.heading: Single Digits Outside, an Uninsulated Attic Inside
body: Rebecca's job was large, and temperatures outside sat in the single digits. The crew worked in the uninsulated attic, the basement and all the spots in between, and they communicated from an ETA of 20 minutes through the entire process. The temperatures never slowed or stopped them from getting through it all.
The company also helped her plan the work as smaller budget items she could schedule out and mark off, so she felt she was progressing.

sections.heading: A Tree Down and the Utility Waiting on the Meter
body: A huge tree landed in Taryn S.'s yard and knocked out power lines. The utility would not restore power unless the meter was fixed. She asked for urgency, and Jimmy and his son made it happen quickly and efficiently.
They also called the utility to confirm that replacing the meter box was all it needed to replace the power lines.

sections.heading: A New Outlet and Damaged Wiring Outside His Parents' House
body: Outside at his parents' house, Jeffrey P. had a new outlet installed and damaged wiring repaired. The guys did an excellent job for his parents, he wrote.

sections.heading: Calling Back for Years
body: Lydia P. has had work done in her house for years, from remodeling projects to repair work, and calls ElectriCraft her first go-to. Phyllis C. has phoned over the past seven years for different issues.
Copp M. hired ElectriCraft for several projects in their home over several years. William M. has used them twice, most recently the day he wrote.

sections.heading: Knew What It Was, Fixed It, Came in Under Budget
body: The electrician knew exactly what the problem was and fixed it quickly, according to les F. Lorenzo S. praised the diagnosis and repair of their electrical issues, and David S. was happy with the job on his home.
Matt S. got a job that came in under budget, and he will use ElectriCraft again.

sections.quote: We hired Electricraft to install a couple of ceiling fans. Jimmy was here promptly at the exact time they said he would be here, he was very professional and very nice and answered all of our questions. …
sections.name: Kirk K.

sections.heading: Ceiling Fans, Sconces, Wafer Lights, Dimmers and a Rebuilt Fixture
body: Customers have had ceiling fans, sconces, wafer lights, ceiling lights in a vaulted ceiling, dimmers and bathroom exhaust fans installed, and a fixture they did not want to lose rebuilt.
Commercial jobs, including emergency lighting, are part of the work too.
Kirk K. is doing additional remodeling and plans to use ElectriCraft for that work. The ceiling fan installation was top notch.

image.alt: Brick ranch house at dusk with porch and path lights on

sections.quote: Jimmy is the absolute BEST!! He totally went above and beyond to rebuild a light fixture I loved. He is responsive, on time, personable and always gets the job done right. Best electrician in town. I send all my friends and family to him! Fantastic experience!
sections.name: Taylor G.

sections.heading: Four More Wafer Lights, a Stair Light and a Wet Bar GFCI
body: Four more wafer lights went into Robert B.'s basement, along with a light under the stairs in a storage area and a GFCI on the wet bar. Jimmy and Ben worked very fast and cleaned up the mess. Both were very professional, he wrote, and the job was done well.
Kathy at the office was professional and friendly, he added, and if you want a job done right, you should give them a call.

sections.heading: Vaulted Ceiling Lights, an Elevated TV Outlet and Dimmers
body: Three times in less than a year, Jennifer D. called ElectriCraft. They added ceiling lights to a vaulted ceiling, installed an elevated outdoor TV outlet, and added multiple indoor outlets and dimmer switches.
Scheduling was thorough and transparent, and the installations look great and function perfectly. She wrote that across four states in five years, Jimmy is the best electrician she has encountered.
Every employee she dealt with was kind, professional and customer-focused, and she gave five stars to ElectriCraft, Jimmy and Travis.

sections.heading: Sconces, an Exhaust Fan and Options You May Not Have Thought Of
body: Jimmy came to Lynn W.'s home and installed sconces; she called him friendly and efficient. Kathy G. had a bathroom exhaust fan put in by Jimmy and Shawn, quick and fantastic in her words, and she will be calling them back for more electrical work. Both crews were friendly and efficient.
Martin N. says Jimmy takes the time to thoroughly understand your needs, offers options you may not have thought of, and explains his completed work.

sections.heading: The Property Inspector Recommended Them Over Anyone in Town
body: Kassandra B. had an exhaust fan put in her bathroom and her panel upgraded. The inspector for the property highly recommended ElectriCraft over anyone in town, and she was glad they did. The crew was friendly and professional through and through, she wrote.

sections.heading: A Breaker Box Moved, With Lights Installed in the Same Job
body: A breaker box relocated and updated came with some lights installed and reinstalled for Taylor R. Everyone was kind and knowledgeable, and the pricing seemed reasonable.
Taylor says ElectriCraft will be the go-to for any electrical needs in the future.

sections.heading: A Call Ahead for an Unexpected Schedule
body: Before the job, the electrician called ahead and was willing to work with Elizabeth's unexpected schedule. Clear communication followed when they discussed installing the lights.
He cleaned up when it was done, and she found the price very reasonable.

sections.heading: Lighting for All Her Needs
body: Justin C. found Jimmy super knowledgeable and great to work with, and everything was installed professionally. dena R. called ElectriCraft a great company for all her lighting needs.
Taylor G. says Jimmy went above and beyond to rebuild a light fixture Taylor loved, and sends friends and family to him.

footer.about: ElectriCraft is a Wichita electrical company serving homes, commercial buildings and industrial sites. We repair, install and upgrade.
why: Weekdays 7 to 5 at 1218 E 18th St North

Your site is laid out at desktop width, so on a phone a visitor scrolls sideways to read it, and your homepage has an empty main headline. Someone at a warm outlet with a phone in hand can't see what you do.

Your reviews describe an electrician who tells people what else they found: wiring that needed protecting, something an inspector missed, what to know about an older house. Today those words sit on Google, not on your site.
So the demo tells one story on every page. It opens with Electrician in Wichita, KS, and gives electrical repair and lighting installation a page each, because your site has no page for either.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Electrician People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: Where Google learns who you are and where you work.
problems: Your homepage has an empty H1. The visible headline, “It's Watt Your Home Needs!”, isn't the H1, so Google can't tell what you are or where.
The copy is general, so it doesn't say what makes a call to you different.
fixes: A headline that says Electrician in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
A page built around what you do on a repair call: fix it, then tell people what else you see.

cards.title: Electrical Repair
cards.why: When an outlet is warm or a breaker keeps tripping, people call the first company they find.
problems: Repair sits inside one long page titled “Residential Electricians in Wichita, KS,” so “electrical repair Wichita KS” has nothing built for it.
fixes: A page for electrical repair in Wichita, KS: what the signs mean, what happens when you call, and when a repair points to something bigger.
cards.alsoAdd: Rebuilt panel upgrade, generator service, and meter box and service line repair pages, each built for its own search.

cards.title: Lighting Installation
cards.why: Fan and lighting jobs are searched for by name.
problems: Your site has no page for lighting installation, so “lighting installation Wichita KS” has nothing built for it.
fixes: A page for lighting installation in Wichita, KS: fans, recessed lights, sconces and dimmers, and what goes into each.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a customer with a dead outlet decides to call.
problems: Your residential FAQ promises 24/7 emergency service while your hours say Monday to Friday, 7 to 5, so a caller at night can't tell whether anyone will answer.
None of your form's five fields is marked required.
fixes: Your address, hours and both numbers together on one page.
One honest line on after-hours calls: call and ask.
A short list of what to have ready when you call.

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: Your customers already describe the company you are. Book a strategy call with Fluid Frame and we’ll walk you through this demo and what a full build adds.

confirm.heading: What we'd confirm with you
confirm.intro: Google and AI tools see different answers about your business in different places. We wrote this demo from your reviews and your site. On a short onboarding call, we'd confirm these so everything says the same thing.
items: Your homepage description says over 30 years, your residential FAQ says over 20 years and your panel page says since 1984, so which number should every listing use?

Your residential FAQ promises 24/7 emergency service, while every page footer says Monday to Friday, 7 to 5 with weekends closed, so which hours should Google show, and how should after-hours callers reach you?
Your site lists 1218 E 18th St North in Wichita, while a BBB listing we found shows a Haysville headquarters, so which address should every listing use?
Your footer prints Kansas Contractor Lic# 1399, but we couldn't check it against a Kansas or Wichita lookup, so what is the license type, and whose name is it under?

lead.heading: Why we led with what your electricians point out
lead.text: We led with what customers say happens after the fix because it lives only in your reviews. Two customers each wrote that the electrician found more than the job they called about, and a generic electrician site can't copy that.

rows.claim: Fix the problem, then tell you plainly what else we see
Storm damage to the meter box or service line, handled with you and the utility
Clean work and a tidy house when we leave
